description: Allowlist for the CI audit gate. Every entry must carry the advisory source id, a remediation reason, and a review date. An id that no longer appears in npm audit output is simply unused.

advisories.reason: Transitive of prisma@5 toolchain — reachable only by the Prisma CLI/config loader on schema files, not by user-controlled runtime input. Fix requires prisma@7 major migration (tracked as DEP-001).
Transitive of prisma@5 — ReDoS requires hostile Schema.TemplateLiteral input to the prisma CLI toolchain; not runtime reachable. Fix requires prisma@7 (DEP-001).
